# WDC — Catalysts

## TL;DR

Q3 FY26 earnings (April 30, 2026) are now 5 trading days old — still within post-catalyst drift window, but late-stage. Analyst upgrade wave (Mizuho $470, TD Cowen $500, BofA $572, JP Morgan ~$530) remains the primary catalyst driver. Q4 FY26 earnings expected July 29–August 5, 2026. Macro partially recovered on May 5 (S&P/Nasdaq ATH), but Iran-UAE/Strait of Hormuz risk is ongoing. [source: web_research/WDC.json, run 20260505_203524]

## Upcoming events

- **Q4 FY26 earnings — July 29–August 5, 2026** (consensus window per web_research/WDC.json; exact date not yet confirmed). Q4 guide: $3.65B ±$100M revenue, gross margin 51–52%, non-GAAP EPS ~$3.25. Well outside the 10-day swing window. [source: web_research/WDC.json earnings_info]
- **HAMR customer qualification status** — 44TB HAMR drives in qualification with 4 hyperscale customers. Volume production targeted CY2027. Any qualification sign-off is a positive catalyst. [source: web_research/WDC.json]
- **Hyperscaler capex prints** — MSFT/META/GOOG/AMZN quarterly cycles are second-derivative read-throughs for HDD demand.
- **AMD earnings (May 5 AMC)** — AI capex barometer. A beat supports the broader AI storage thesis.

## Recent news synthesis

- **Q3 FY26 beat (April 30, 2026):** Revenue $3.3B (+45% YoY, beats est), EPS $2.72 blowout. First-ever gross margin above 50% (50.5%). Cloud = 89% of revenue. Q4 guide raised to $3.65B ±$100M. [source: web_research/WDC.json earnings_info]
- **WDC shares +8.21% on May 5** (leading storage sector per TradingKey May 5, 2026). Stock surged 4–8% post-earnings and continued higher. [source: web_research/WDC.json ticker_news]
- **Dividend increased 20%** to $0.15/share. CEO cited three AI-driven tailwinds: training storage, agentic AI inferencing, and synthetic/physical AI data; >25% CAGR exabyte growth target. [source: web_research/WDC.json ticker_news]
- **Analyst upgrade wave (May 1, 2026):** Mizuho $470, TD Cowen $500, BofA $572, JP Morgan ~$530; 25-analyst consensus: 20 Strong Buy, 1 Moderate Buy, 4 Hold, 0 Sell. Avg PT per web_research: ~$450 (pre-earnings PTs now being run past as stock trades ~$465). [source: web_research/WDC.json analyst_consensus]
- **Macro partial recovery (May 5):** S&P 500 +0.81% (ATH 7,259.22), Nasdaq +1.03% (record 25,326.13). Oil eased to WTI ~$104.10 after Iran-UAE escalation May 4. Iran-UAE/Strait of Hormuz conflict ongoing — unresolved tail risk. [source: web_research/WDC.json macro_context]

## Insider activity

- CEO Irving Tan: 10b5-1 sale of 20K restricted shares on 2026-02-02; 49 shares dividend-equivalent conversion Mar 24. Holds 618,150 shares.
- CLO Cynthia Tregillis: 363 shares sold at $377.09 under 10b5-1 plan (Apr 22, 2026).
- Form 144 filed May 2026 for 4,674 restricted shares (potential sale by insider, routine). [source: web_research/WDC.json ticker_news, competitor_activity]
- No open-market insider purchases. 10b5-1 plan sales only — routine, not a strong signal.

## Last updated

2026-05-05 — run 20260505_203524. Updated: post-earnings catalyst now 5 days old (was 2 days); macro updated to partial recovery + Nasdaq ATH; analyst avg PT updated per web_research/WDC.json. Supersedes 2026-05-04 entry (run 20260504_203608). Sources: web_research/WDC.json (2026-05-05).

## Format

Each lesson is one dated bullet:

`[DATE] | [TICKER] | [SETUP TYPE] | [OUTCOME: +$X / -$X] | [WHY it worked or failed in 1 sentence]`

The "why" should reference: the thesis at the time, the macro regime, which swing strategy recommended it.

## Lessons

2026-04-30 | NVDA | EMA pullback Fib dip-buy | -$63.20 (corrected from -$264.65) | Stop triggered at $205.30 (hourly Fib 61.8%); swing_trend_momentum and swing_breakout were bullish on AI capex thesis, but price breached the stop zone intraday amid stretched macro (RSI 81–87) with no bullish confirmation candle before exit. **Note:** trade was originally sized 67 shares ($14,020) due to a phantom $100K budget bug (fixed commit b2b472d). With the correct $25K budget at 14.2% vol-adj limit, position would have been 16 shares ($3,348). Corrected P&L reflects the strategy's actual signal quality, not the sizing error.
2026-05-04 | AMZN | mean-reversion fade short | OUTCOME: -$10.14 | Mean-reversion short thesis (April 30 shooting star, RSI 82–88) stopped at $276 as extreme ADX 65 trend absorbed the reversal; swing_mean_reversion recommended the setup but the regime (ADX 60+) sets an elevated bar for fading overbought conditions confirmed by identical NVDA stop-out April 30.
2026-05-05 | DIS | pre-earnings breakout long | OUTCOME: -$4.99 | Pre-earnings breakout above $103 (4/5 swing agents bullish, swing_breakout and swing_trend_momentum) invalidated by macro reversal (Iran escalation May 4, WTI +$105) that converted the April 30 risk-on tailwind into a risk-off headwind; sub-threshold entry volume (1.23x vs. 1.5x minimum) was an early warning sign.
